_comment: Who wrote the words of the works added to the Layers cite list on 2026-11-01, as the founder asked that day (Lowth, Jebb, Boys, Forbes, Horne, Keach and De Laune, Augustine, MacArthur and Keller). Each record gives the words that name the writer, as printed or as the page shows them, and where they were read; all were read on 2026-11-01.
MacArthur's and Keller's sermons are copyrighted: the records hold the speaker line only, and nothing of a sermon is quoted anywhere.

records.note: The words are the archive.org record's transcription of the title page; the title page's OCR also reads 'Lately Professor of Poetry in the University of Oxford, and Lord Bishop of London'. The 1816 printing's record names 'Lowth, Robert, 1710-1787' and 'Gregory, G. (George), 1754-1808'.
